initial_candidate_caveat: An early Chrome profile was started before network-isolation flags; lsof recorded a connection to local proxy 127.0.0.1:7890 and Chrome was stopped. Proxy forwarding cannot be determined from this evidence. Later locked Chrome had only loopback sockets.
external_business_calls: None intended; all API/provider interactions were loopback/Fake. Due to the early local-proxy caveat, the report does not assert a network-wide zero-external-request guarantee for the entire attempt.
shutdown: API, Vite, Chrome and helper processes were terminated; follow-up process/socket audit found no listeners on 18927/17327/19327.
terminal_redaction: API shutdown stdout included a Fake callback query state. It was not written to evidence or committed; callback state is omitted from all checked-in records.
